newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds follow easier Chicago led.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds follow easier Chicago led.

text.p: Lower Chicago futures led to easier UK meals and feeds prices but buyers failed to respond.
"There has hardly been a sniff of a buyers all day," said one broker.
High protein soymeal sellers were as much as three stg down ex-mill and store while rapemeal was one stg lower ex-mill Hull and Liverpool.
Rapemeal ex-mill Erith and sunflower meal and pellets were unchanged.
Corn gluten pellets ex-store Liverpool and Portbury were one to two stg down.
